description: Source code for an exception handler in the Google Breakpad project, specifically for Solaris platform. Implements signal handling, minidump creation, and handler management.

classes.name: ExceptionHandler
classes.description: Manages signal handlers for exceptions, creates minidumps, and handles crash reporting.

methods.name: ExceptionHandler
methods.description: Constructor that sets up exception handling and handler stack.

methods.name: Destructor
methods.description: Cleans up handlers and handler stack.

methods.name: SetupHandler
methods.description: Sets up signal handlers for specific signals.

methods.name: HandleException
methods.description: Static method invoked when a signal occurs; manages minidump creation and handler chain.

methods.name: InternalWriteMinidump
methods.description: Performs the actual minidump creation, including GUID generation and signal blocking.
